title: Samar Bora Apologises After Mayabini Rendition Sparks Protests in Tezpur

ai.summary: Samar Bora's rock-style rendition of Zubeen Garg's song 'Mayabini' at a tribute event in Tezpur sparked audience protests demanding an apology, leading to a temporary interruption before the programme resumed with other performers.

facts.claim: Samar Bora's rock-style rendition of 'Mayabini' sparked protests at the tribute programme
facts.quote: A rock-style rendition of Zubeen Garg’s iconic song ‘Mayabini’ by local singer Samar Bora sparked protests at the late singer’s 54th birth anniversary tribute programme in Tezpur on 18th November.

facts.claim: Audience demanded the singer leave the stage and a public apology
facts.quote: The audience reportedly expressed dissatisfaction with the rendition and demanded that the singer leave the stage. They also called for a public apology over his performance of the popular Assamese song.

facts.claim: Samar Bora publicly apologised before leaving the stage
facts.quote: Following the audience's objections, Samar Bora publicly apologised before leaving the stage.
